answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond at the inlet with one sample: the applicant speaks the comet code aloud, bound to that key. Auditors verify the code, compare voiceprints, and burn bonds for reused samples. A fake needs a distinct performer, so the kth fake pays 70 locked plus 30 plus 2 times k minus 1, a recruitment spiral. For 1,000 fakes: 70,000 locked plus 1,029,000 in fees. A rented-actor farm fails: the comet code cannot be prerecorded, and a repeated voiceprint exposes the cluster. An honest agent speaks once, posts one bond, and recovers it after a clean epoch.
